text: Tighten the rear wheel spindle to 70 Nm. After adjusting the chain, make sure both wheels are aligned before tightening the rear wheel spindle nut. The manual gives this torque only within the drive chain adjustment steps. The rear wheel assembly steps tell you to tighten the hex nut without giving a torque value.
